text:
maria: FYI ran into a reproducible break in the sample SSR app when building with Vite + scope-hoisting plugin. Edge runtime throws "ReferenceError: exports is not defined" on our js-sdk bundle.

jonathan: ugh, can you paste minimal repro steps? is this happening in dev or only after build?

maria: only during optimized build (vite build --ssr). Dev server works fine. steps: clone (private sample), set NODE_ENV=production, install, then:

# reproduce
yarn install
VITE_SDK_TARGET=edge yarn build:ssr
# serve the SSR artifact in an edge-like environment (local es module runner)
node --experimental-modules ./dist/server/entry.mjs

Error surfacing as runtime crash when importing the sdk in server bundle.

li: can you paste vite config + package.json deps? suspect rollup plugin ordering or cjs interop.

maria: package.json deps (relevant):

"dependencies": {
  "@redwood-inference/js-sdk": "^0.12.0",
  "some-edge-lib": "^2.1.0"
}
"devDependencies": {
  "vite": "4.2.1",
  "vite-plugin-scope-hoist": "0.3.0",
  "@rollup/plugin-commonjs": "21.0.1"
}

vite.config.ts snippet:

import scopeHoist from 'vite-plugin-scope-hoist'
export default defineConfig({
  build: {
    ssr: true,
    rollupOptions: {
      plugins: [scopeHoist()]
    }
  }
})

sam: interesting. scope-hoist rewrites modules to assume ESM semantics; if sdk ships a CJS-compatible bundle (with `exports`), hoisting can drop the wrapper and then `exports` isn't defined in the newer ESM output. Can you show the stack trace?

maria: stack (trimmed):

ReferenceError: exports is not defined
    at file:///workspace/node_modules/@redwood-inference/js-sdk/dist/index.js:1:7
    at file:///workspace/dist/server/entry.mjs:45:12
    at ModuleJob.run (internal/modules/esm/module_job.js:123:25)

li: yeah that line number is consistent with the bundle being transformed but still using `exports.__esModule` style helpers. quick workaround: disable scope-hoist for server build or force commonjs plugin to transform mixed modules:

commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true }

But that is a workaround, not a fix for DX.

sam: long term options: (1) we publish an ESM-only entry for edge runtimes (exports field in package.json) and ensure it has no CJS wrappers, OR (2) add a build-time compatibility check in the SDK that warns if bundle looks like CJS-only. We already discussed ESM-first in product notes.

maria: Agreed. For the immediate repro, I created a tiny repo that toggles scope-hoist on/off and shows the crash. Will upload to the sample-app org. Want to track as DX bug because this is a common Vite config for folks trying to reduce size.

jonathan: can you attach the repo link here and a minimal patch that fixes it locally? I'll take ownership of triage and propose a small SDK publish change.

maria: link: https://git.internal/sampleapp/vite-scope-hoist-repro (private) — steps and two branches: `original` (breaks) and `no-hoist` (works). Patch I used locally: in sdk dist I replaced default export wrapper with named export and updated package.json to have "module" pointing to ESM file. Not ideal for a release but proves the root cause.

li: another note: users with `esModuleInterop=false` in tsconfig can hit type mismatches when switching between cjs/esm entries. Might want to add a section in the devex docs: "If you use Vite scope-hoisting or advanced Rollup plugins, prefer SDK ESM entrypoint or set transformMixedEsModules."

sam: I'll open a tiny RFC: publish an explicit `exports` map in SDK package.json with `import` -> ESM dist and `require` -> CJS dist. That should let node/vite pick the right file. Also add a CI test that builds a Vite SSR sample with `scope-hoist` plugin enabled to prevent regressions.

maria: thanks. marking this thread as the repro report — will add logs + repo link to the ticket. @jonathan please add the triage label. :+1:

deploy-bot: CI for sampleapp/vite-scope-hoist-repro completed: 1 failed, 3 passed. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/6421 (private)

jonathan: took triage. opening bug: SDK-2457. assign to @sam for export map RFC, draft PR incoming with small test.

maria: awesome, thanks team. For anyone hitting this: short-term workaround is: remove scope-hoist for server build or set `commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules=true` in Vite config.

li: adding note to devex docs about bundler pitfalls and the exact Vite options to try.

sam: fwiw, this also surfaced in a customer's Dedicated deployment; high-impact enough for a patch release.

maria: closing thread, will post updates in the ticket.
